intro: AZW3 to PDF converts books in AZW3, also known as KF8, the format of current Kindles, into a PDF you can open without a Kindle or the Amazon app, print or share. It works, for example, for books you have prepared yourself, personal documents you sent to your Kindle or unprotected books that some publishers sell in this format.

The layout is done by Calibre's ebook-convert on our server. It keeps the book's chapters, images and styles and flows the text onto pages of the paper you choose: A5 by default, A4 or Letter. The margins, 15 mm by default, can be set between 0 and 50 mm, and the base font, 12 points by default, between 6 and 36.

The table of contents goes at the start if you leave that option on. Calibre generates it at the end, and we move those pages to the front and number the PDF with the contents in roman numerals and the book from 1, so the numbers in the contents match the ones in your viewer's toolbar.

Books bought from the Kindle store usually carry DRM, an encryption that prevents opening them outside Amazon's devices and apps, and those cannot be converted. Calibre works in an isolated process, without network and with time and memory limits, and each PDF is subject to your plan's page limit: 100 without an account, 300 with a free account and 2000 with Pro. With several books you also get a ZIP.
steps: Upload one or more AZW3 books.
Choose the paper, the margins, the font and whether you want the table of contents at the start.
Download the PDF or the ZIP with all of them.

faq.q: How do I know whether my book has DRM?
faq.a: If the conversion fails with a purchased book and works with others, it is most likely protected. Books you converted to AZW3 yourself and those the publisher sells without DRM convert without trouble.
A5 for reading on screen or printing in book format; A4 or Letter if you are going to print on a home printer and want fewer pages.
Yes. The books and the PDFs are deleted after one hour if you have no account or after 24 hours if you do.
